title: Longitudinal Study of Kid's Speech (LoKiS corpus)
why_promising: Primary longitudinal German child production with six recording waves (2020-2025), roughly 60 children initially, picture naming, counting, sentence repetition and picture description. The current corpus page states that all recordings are segmented and annotated and that individual words and segments are searchable. The linked 2023 JSLHR first-wave study explicitly reports WebMAUS TextGrids manually checked and corrected, with target-word boundaries checked/corrected in Praat and acoustic measures including f0, formants/vowel space, HNR, tempo and sibilant CoG/skewness.
open_question: Corpus access is currently by contacting the project rather than an openly downloadable deposit. Verify whether the searchable database/export exposes the manually corrected word/segment tiers and derived measurements under reusable terms. If access becomes public, ingest only production layers with documented human verification; retain longitudinal wave and participant linkage.
